name: Nakai the Wanderer
canonNotes: An ancient Kroxigor of the First Spawning, revered by Skink priests as a jungle spirit made flesh.
Masterless since Tlanxla fell, he wanders wherever the Great Plan needs him.
voiceNotes: Near-silent, primal and ominous; his words are rare and simple.
Guided by portents and the Plan.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
